title: Sign in and reach the dashboard
description: Verifies a user can log in with valid credentials and reach the dashboard successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard
Verify the dashboard financial summary is displayed

title: Create a transaction and see wallet balance update

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form

Start adding a new transaction
Fill a valid amount greater than 0 into the amount field
Select a category
Select a wallet
Save the transaction
Verify the new transaction is listed in the transactions list
Verify the selected wallet balance reflects the newly added transaction

title: Auto-save high-confidence AI capture with undo
description: Verifies that a high-confidence AI chat capture auto-saves a transaction, offers undo, and the transaction can be removed via undo.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation link to capture
Open AI chat capture mode
Fill "Lunch 45000 cash today" into the AI chat input
Submit the AI chat message
Wait for the capture result to complete
Click the undo action for the recently saved capture
Verify the capture success state is cleared after undo
Verify no new transaction from the AI capture appears in the transactions list

Select a subset of parsed rows to import
Select a target wallet for the import
Confirm the import
Click the navigation link to open the transactions page
Verify newly imported transactions are displayed in the transactions list
Verify the target wallet balance reflects the imported transactions
